name: The watcher: a searchlight she draws while you cross
body: Reframed as a stealth searchlight section. She takes the open spot unprompted and holds the beam while you cross to cover, then you meet at the far end. The beam visibility itself is another thread's.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).
